title: Heroes of the Bible Quiz
description: Let's see what you remember about our Bible heroes!

questions.question: What did Noah build?
questions.explanation: Noah built a big Ark! God told Noah to build the Ark to keep the animals safe from the flood (Genesis 6:14).

questions.question: What did God promise Abraham?
questions.explanation: God promised Abraham a big family — as many as the stars in the sky! And God kept His promise (Genesis 12:2).

questions.question: Where was baby Moses found?
options: In a basket on the river
questions.explanation: Baby Moses was found in a basket on the river by a princess (Exodus 2:5-6).

questions.question: Who did David fight with God's help?
questions.explanation: David fought the giant Goliath! David trusted God and was brave (1 Samuel 17:45).

questions.question: What happened to Daniel in the lions' den?
questions.explanation: God kept Daniel safe! God sent an angel to close the lions' mouths (Daniel 6:22).
